title: PR #15 — Vault list, filters, keyboard navigation, and search
description: Render the decrypted vault list with sorting, filtering, keyboard navigation, a command-palette search, and an empty state, all computed in memory over cached ciphertext. Requirement IDs: TASK-38, TASK-39.
acceptanceCriteria: List rows show decrypted name, secondary line (username or note snippet), folder, favorite, and type
Sorting by name and updated-at works; filtering by type, folder, and favorite works and combines
Keyboard navigation supports arrow keys and `j`/`k`, Enter to open, and `Ctrl/Cmd+K` to focus search
Search matches name, username, URL, and notes substring with debounce and match highlighting
Search performs no network request and works offline
A 500-item list renders without visible jank or layout thrash
An empty vault shows a primary call to action to create the first item
Every action is reachable by keyboard alone

steps.details: Create `app/lib/vault/selectors.ts` that takes cached ciphertext rows, opens each envelope with the in-memory key, and returns a memoized list of `{ id, type, favorite, folderId, rev, updatedAt, decrypted: { name, username, url, notes } }`. Cache results by `rev` and invalidate on cache writes.

Create `app/routes/vault.tsx` as a transport-only route plus the page entry `app/features/vault-list/vault-list.tsx` with `index.ts`, `components/`, and `vault-list.hooks.ts`. Use a two-pane layout on desktop (list + detail placeholder) and a single-pane flow on mobile. Render rows with name, secondary line, folder chip, favorite star, and type icon. Include a toolbar with new-item, sort, and filter controls.
Add a reducer for `{ sort: 'name'|'updated', direction, type?, folderId?, favoriteOnly }`. Persist the preference in the `meta` store. Apply filters before sorting and memoize by the filter key.
Add a roving tabindex list with ArrowUp/ArrowDown and `j`/`k`, Enter to open, Escape to clear focus, and a visible focus ring. Ensure shortcuts do not fire while typing in an input or textarea.

Add a `Ctrl/Cmd+K` command palette using the dialog primitive with a debounced input (150ms), matching over decrypted fields, highlighted substrings, and keyboard selection. Show a short empty-result message. No fetch calls.

steps.description: Add the empty and locked states
steps.details: Empty vault: illustration-free message plus a primary new-item button. Locked: render nothing beyond the lock overlay. Loading: skeleton rows sized to the final row height to avoid layout shift.

Add a fixture with 1000 cached items; measure initial decrypt+render and search latency in a Playwright trace. Assert search under 100ms and no long task over 200ms during scrolling. Verify offline search by blocking the network.

technicalNotes: Decrypt only what is needed; do not keep decrypted objects in a global store longer than necessary.
Search must never hit the server; the server cannot read names by design.
Virtualize the list only if measurement shows it is needed for 1000 items; do not add a dependency preemptively.
Keyboard shortcuts must be inert inside editable fields.
Folder names are ciphertext too; decrypt them with the same selector layer.

pullRequest.title: feat(vault): list, filters, keyboard navigation, and search
pullRequest.scope: Decryption selectors, list surface, sort/filter state, keyboard nav, command palette search, empty/locked states.
pullRequest.outOfScope: Item editors, generators, trash, responsive polish beyond the single-pane flow.
